meaning:
βραδύς, -εῖα, -ύ,
slow: εἰς τὸ λαλῆσαι, Jas.1:19; metaphorically, of the understanding: β. τ. καρδίᾳ, assoc. with ἀνόητος, Luk.24:25.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
